scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。

papers.title: AMDKernelVault: Large-Scale Datasets and Agentic Training for AMD GPU Kernel Optimization
papers.authors: Ji Liu, Saptarshi Majumder, Yiqing Huang, Wenwen Ouyang, Umang Pandey, Zeping Li, Chushi Chen, Zihao An, Puyuan Yang, Zekai Li, Sina Rafati, Ziqiong Liu, Pratik Prabhanjan Brahma, Dong Li, Zicheng Liu, Sharon Zhou, Emad Barsoum
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.12471v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We introduce AMDKernelVault, an open HIP and Triton kernel corpus and training framework for recent AMD CDNA GPUs. Existing LLM-based kernel agents are largely CUDA/NVIDIA-centric and often depend on repeated frontier-LLM calls for generation, reflection, and optimization. To address this gap, we develop HIPKernelGen and TritonKernelGen, agent-driven pipelines that transform PyTorch references into HIP or Triton kernels, compile and validate candidates under ROCm, and latency-profile them on AMD hardware. The corpus contains 62,153 execution-verified HIP kernel samples, 2,377 production-grounded ROCm Libraries QA entries, and 39,893 Triton kernels. We further train Qwen3-8B with supervised fine-tuning and execution-aware reinforcement learning as a demonstration of the corpus's utility. Under fixed evaluation budgets, it achieves the highest correctness among the compared models on PyTorch-to-HIP (34.0% Pass@1), TritonBench-G (33.2% Corr
papers.summary: AMDKernelVault为AMD GPU提供可执行验证的HIP与Triton内核语料，包含62,153个HIP样本和39,893个Triton内核。作者以Qwen3-8B进行监督与执行反馈训练，在PyTorch到HIP任务中Pass@1为34.0%，ROCmBench的Corr@3为41.94%，但速度指标并非全面领先。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索若将向量生成或LLM服务迁移到AMD硬件，可复用其编译、正确性检查与真机测速闭环，先覆盖高频算子再训练生成模型。核心借鉴是把可执行反馈作为训练证据，并分别衡量编译率、正确率与实际加速；不能因生成代码通过测试，就假定在线重排延迟一定下降。

papers.title: Argus: Orchestrating Cross-Layer GPU Performance Measurements around Semantic Regions
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.12299v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: GPU developers and automated optimizers need performance evidence for semantic code regions--such as neural-network operator implementations and pipeline stages--but this evidence is fragmented across profiling tools. Answering a region-level question can require manually constructing probes and program variants, isolating interfering measurements, and mapping evidence to regions and execution contexts. We present Argus, a region-centric measurement planner and runtime that automates this workflow. Clients identify regions with boundary markers and select signals and execution scopes. Argus preserves region identity across compilation, execution, and measurement variants, constructs interference-aware multi-run plans, and orchestrates transformations and profiling across backends. It joins compiler-, hardware-, and system-level evidence using region identity and dynamic execution context, producing reports that record measurement origins and attribution ambiguity.
  We evaluate Argus across agentic kernel optimization, persistent megakernel optimization, and cross-level PGO. Across 44 persistent-GEMM and attention configurations, Argus improves 39/44 cases and raises AlphaEvolve's geometric-mean speedup from 5.4% to 8.9%. On a persistent TinyLlama-1.1B decode megakernel, an optimization agent reaches 1.65 ms/token with Argus versus 4.92 ms/token without it, producing a kernel $2.1\times$ faster than PyTorch with CUDA Graphs. Finally, Argus-guided cross-level PGO improves compute--communication overlap, increasing throughput by 7% on average across five multi-GPU settings.
papers.authors: Jianzhu Yao, Yue Guan, Srivatsan Ramesh, Yuanwei Fang, Jian Jiao, Boda Li, Yueming Hao, Xinwei Qiang, Pramod Viswanath, Yufei Ding, Bill Yoshimi, Alexey Loginov, Shane Nay, Adnan Aziz
papers.summary: 论文针对GPU性能证据分散在编译器、内核和系统工具中的问题，提出按语义代码区域组织测量的Argus。它保持跨执行变体的区域身份，并安排避免相互干扰的多轮测量；44组配置中39组获益，TinyLlama解码优化达到1.65毫秒/token，对照为4.92毫秒/token。
papers.key_insight: 对社区UGC搜索的LLM改写与重排服务，先把慢请求定位到具体算子区域，再选择融合、访存或通信优化。可借鉴其区域标记与执行上下文联合归因，避免把不同运行条件下的计数器直接拼接；论文结果来自指定内核与硬件，迁移后仍需检查端到端延迟及nDCG稳定性。

papers.title: ForgeMegakernel: A General Framework for Efficient Auto-Regressive Model Decode Megakernels
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.12379v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Auto-regressive model decode is bandwidth-bound, since every weight and key/value-cache byte crosses high-bandwidth memory once per token. A megakernel is an ideal solution, but existing automatic megakernel generation approaches cannot achieve both generalization across models and correctness guarantees.
  We present ForgeMegakernel, which generates a per-model high-performance decode megakernel using coding agents. ForgeMegakernel pairs a universal knowledge base of ten progressive milestones with an independent mid-state test oracle. The milestones provide the megakernel's structural properties: a fine-grained instruction stream for each SM, dependency counters replacing the global synchronization, and a shared-memory buffer pool for workload balance across SMs and greater parallelism. The test oracle derives the mid-states of the megakernel and checks the performance, error and precision during the generation process, guaranteeing a correct and trustworthy forged megakernel.
  We evaluated ForgeMegakernel on 14 representative decoding operations across eight model families spanning 0.6B-13B parameters. The generated megakernels achieved 50.5-85.9% MBU and geometric mean speedups of 1.21x over SGLang 0.5.18 and 1.54x over a megakernel compiler under identical configurations. Inside SGLang, evaluated on GSM8K with ragged prompts, all 14 megakernels decoded faster than the SGLang engine at comparable answer accuracy.
papers.authors: Leshan Li, Zhui Zhu, Xianglong Deng, Yaojian Chen, Qingfeng He, Yuxuan Li, Rong Zhao, Xu Han, Zhiyuan Liu
papers.summary: ForgeMegakernel以编码智能体生成模型专属的持久解码内核，用十个递进里程碑指导结构构建，并用独立中间状态校验器检查数值。评测覆盖8个模型家族、14种解码操作，带宽利用率为50.5%—85.9%，相对SGLang 0.5.18的几何平均加速为1.21倍。
papers.key_insight: 对社区搜索的查询改写和答案生成，小模型逐token解码可能比大矩阵乘法更受访存与启动开销约束。可借鉴细粒度SM指令流、依赖计数及中间状态回归检查，把融合收益与正确性一起验证；上线仍需覆盖真实短文本、变长批次和并发，实验中的答案准确率相近不等于所有请求等价。

papers.title: SGLang and Miles Add Day-0 Support for DeepSeek-V4.1
papers.abstract: 通过Engram主存卸载、跨层缓存共享和滑窗有限重放优化推理，并对齐训练与rollout。KV容量增加36%，prefill最高加速1.56倍。
papers.summary: SGLang与Miles针对DeepSeek-V4.1加入跨层缓存共享、Engram主存卸载及滑窗有限重放。4张GB300上主存卸载使KV缓存容量增加36%；8张H200上的有限重放将预填充吞吐提升1.56倍，配对GB300评测的AIME样本正确数均为453/480。
papers.key_insight: 对UGC搜索中共享长前缀的生成服务，应分别测量缓存容量收益、重放代价和实际答案质量，再决定是否启用近似路径。文章明确有限重放会改变边界隐状态，因此相同基准得分不能视为数值等价；部署可借鉴将训练与服务量化语义对齐，并用真实query评估尾延迟、相关性及成本。

papers.title: Unleashing the Power of Equality Saturation for Tensor Program Superoptimization
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.12330v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Efficient GPU implementations of tensor programs often require joint optimization of high-level algebraic formulations and low-level execution strategies. However, the resulting search space grows rapidly as transformations combine across operators, making joint optimization difficult to scale. We present EqiForge, a tensor program superoptimizer based on equality saturation. Its unified IR represents high-level tensor expressions and tiled computations in a single expression language. By composing equality rules, EqiForge derives fused implementations such as FlashAttention-style kernels directly from tensor expressions. Early compaction prunes redundant partial programs before completion, while subgraph composition extends the search to larger graphs. Across tensor-program benchmarks, EqiForge achieves a geometric mean speedup of 1.32x and a maximum of 2.74x over the fastest available baseline per configuration. Its attention kernels outperform FlashAttention by up to 1.87x in decode and approach its performance in prefill. EqiForge also discovers new implementations that outperform torch.compile on various Transformer layers, including QK-normalized MLA (3.16x) and mHC (5.84x).
papers.authors: Qi Zhan, Xing Hu, Xin Xia, Shanping Li
papers.summary: 论文提出基于等式饱和的张量程序优化器EquiForge，用统一表示同时描述高层代数表达和底层分块计算。通过提前压缩冗余候选及子图组合控制搜索规模，相对各配置最快基线取得1.32倍几何平均加速；解码注意力最高为FlashAttention的1.87倍。
papers.key_insight: UGC搜索在线推理常由小批次注意力、归一化和投影共同决定耗时，可将这些组合算子作为整体搜索等价实现。方法的价值在于联动代数改写与执行布局，而非只调单个内核；部署前要按实际序列长度、批量与精度校验收益，不能将局部加速直接视为CTR或整链路提升。

papers.title: Accelerating Dropless MoE Training in JAX with NVIDIA Transformer Engine
papers.abstract: Mixture of experts (MoE) has become one of the defining architectural trends in large-scale AI model training. DeepSeek, Qwen, and Mixtral are examples of MoE...
papers.summary: NVIDIA介绍JAX与Transformer Engine的dropless MoE训练优化，通过分组GEMM、MXFP8量化及融合专家通信处理不等长token负载。DeepSeek-V3在GB200上的性能由103升至1,068 TFLOPS/GPU，约10.4倍；另在GB300的1,024卡扩展测试中保持97%效率。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索团队若训练MoE语义模型或共享基础模型，应先拆解专家计算与分发回收的时间，再决定量化、通信融合或主存卸载的优先级。可借鉴按真实token数执行分组矩阵运算及同节点传输去重；文中收益相对未优化基线且依赖Blackwell集群，不能直接套用于小型推理集群。

papers.title: Dissecting GPU Utilization for LLM Inference on Nvidia Hopper
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.12923v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: A single SM utilization percentage can make an LLM inference workload look compute-saturated while hiding how much useful work is being done. The problem is not that the counter is wrong, but that it collapses several different mechanisms into one number. This is most severe during decode, where each request contributes only one new token and dense projection GEMMs become small-row matrix multiplications. On Hopper, the bfloat16 GMMA path executes these operations in fixed 64-row matrix fragments, so small-batch decode can fill only a small fraction of each fragment with real token rows.
  In this paper, we profile vLLM with FlashAttention-3 and cuBLASLt on an H100 NVL across cold prefill, warm prefill, and decode, sweeping sequence length and batch size. We replace the usual single utilization number with eight counter-validated views derived from raw Nsight Compute reports, each pinned to an NCU counter or explicit formula. Together, these views map utilization gaps to concrete mechanisms - fragment fill, occupancy limits, stall signatures, wave quantization, and kernel selection - across four production models and six per-layer kernel roles.
papers.authors: Mohammad Siavashi, Gerald Q. Maguire Jr., Dejan Kostic, Marco Chiesa
papers.summary: 论文在H100 NVL上剖析vLLM推理，以8类可对照硬件计数器的视图拆解利用率，覆盖4个模型和6类层内核。Qwen3-14B在批量32解码时显示约72%的SM忙碌度，但Hopper的64行矩阵片段仅半数装入真实token，说明单一利用率会掩盖有效计算不足。
papers.key_insight: 为UGC搜索推理服务做容量规划时，应同时观察真实矩阵填充、显存停顿、占用率与请求时延，避免看到GPU忙碌就直接扩容。可按冷预填充、缓存命中预填充和解码分别采样，再在nDCG与CTR不变的前提下调整批量；该文属于性能诊断，不提供一项可直接套用的吞吐加速比例。

papers.title: Zipbench: Low-Cost Framework for Compressing Comprehensive Benchmarks of Large Language Models
papers.authors: Zhongzhan Huang, Junxin Li, Guoming Ling, Yupei Lin, Shanshan Zhong, Hefeng Wu
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.12475v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Comprehensive benchmark suites are essential for improving large language models (LLMs), but many widely used benchmarks are redundant, making evaluation unnecessarily expensive. Although recent benchmark compression methods (BCMs) can mitigate this cost, many strong BCMs rely on large collections of per-sample evaluation results from numerous LLMs to identify representative samples. Building such collections is also expensive unless they are already public, making these methods difficult to extend to newly released benchmarks. To address this challenge, we present ZipBench, a simple and low-cost BCM with theoretical error and rank-consistency guarantees. ZipBench evaluates only a small set of anchor LLMs, synthesizes pseudo evaluation results to broaden coverage, learns compact sample representations, and selects a small yet representative subset. Building on it, we create ZipBench Zoo, a collection of compact versions of 100+ benchmark
papers.summary: ZipBench通过少量锚点模型的评测结果合成伪评测信号，学习样本表示后选取紧凑而有代表性的测试子集。其开源集合覆盖100余个文本、多模态与智能体基准，和完整评测相比平均绝对误差为0.002—0.02，平均Spearman相关系数约0.98。
papers.key_insight: 社区UGC搜索频繁迭代改写模型与LLM评审器时，可以建立便宜的每日回归子集，缩短候选方案筛选周期。子集应覆盖长尾query、噪声短文本与各业务切片，并定期回到全量nDCG和人工相关性评估；通用基准上的高相关性不能直接保证自有搜索数据的小幅提升也能被可靠区分。

papers.title: HoliBench: A Cross-Platform Benchmarking and Deployment Toolkit for Foundation Models in CPS-IoT Applications
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.12412v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Foundation models, including large language models, vision-language models, and time-series foundation models, are increasingly deployed on embedded and edge platforms for CPS and IoT applications, where energy, latency, and memory are as critical as task accuracy. Existing benchmarking tools evaluate model capability in isolation, reporting accuracy assuming sufficient compute, while hardware profiling tools remain platform-specific and mutually incompatible. As a result, users lack a unified workflow for making deployment decisions across heterogeneous devices. We present HoliBench, a modular benchmarking and deployment toolkit that jointly characterizes accuracy, latency, and energy across platforms from single-board computers to GPU servers. Its platform abstraction layer calibrates cross-device measurement, and the toolkit supports multiple model modalities, inference engines, concurrencies, and existing evaluation harnesses. An interactive interface exposes constraint-aware configuration selection over a design space that is profiled once and reused across studies. Using HoliBench, we characterize 20 models across 7 device types, 3 quantization levels, 8 inference backends, and over 30 tasks, surfacing tradeoffs that existing tools miss: quantization reduces latency only on hardware with low-precision support, accuracy gains show diminishing returns relative to energy, and for autoregressive workloads, average inference power is approximately constant across output lengths. We further find that single-model profiles compose under sequential co-resident execution. In a multi-model CPS deployment, standalone profiles predict combined-pipeline latency and power within 1.2% and 2.5%, enabling deployment exploration without exhaustively profiling every pipeline configuration. We release HoliBench as open-source infrastructure for deployment-aware evaluation of foundation models.
papers.authors: Inesh Chakrabarti, Zejun Xiong, Pragya Sharma, Mani Srivastava
papers.summary: HoliBench统一不同硬件上的模型质量、延迟与能耗测量，并支持按部署约束选择配置。作者评测20个模型、7类设备、3档量化及8个推理后端；在顺序共驻的多模型管线中，单模型测量预测整管线延迟和功耗的误差分别控制在1.2%与2.5%以内。
papers.key_insight: 对社区搜索中的向量生成、query理解和重排模型，可以先积累可复用的设备配置测量表，再比较成本与质量折中。其启示是量化是否提速取决于硬件低精度支持，模型精度也必须纳入选择；顺序共驻的可组合结论不应直接用于高并发共享GPU场景，需补测干扰及尾延迟。

papers.title: Infer-forge: Harness, Loop, and Graph Engineering Around SGLang
papers.abstract: 内部推理工程系统，以可复现环境、长期任务循环和任务图组织优化。在四个月记录中单工程师峰值并行任务由2增至9，一个服务项目含38个可验证任务。未开源，未给出因果效率实验。
papers.authors: Tianyu Zhang, Hanlin Gao, Yusong Gao, Yun Zhang
papers.summary: Infer-forge介绍围绕SGLang开展长期推理优化的内部工程系统，用稳定执行环境、任务循环和任务图保存实验上下文。四个月观察记录中，单工程师峰值在途任务数由2增至9，一个服务项目组织38个可验证任务；这是工程观察，未证明因果效率提升，系统也尚未开源。
papers.key_insight: UGC搜索推理优化往往跨越模型、内核和服务配置，可借鉴把每次结论绑定到模型版本、GPU、工作负载与SLO，并记录失败路径及交接证据。实践重点是让重排与生成服务的实验可复现、可回滚，而非照搬内部系统；衡量成果应看已验证的延迟与成本收益，不能只统计并行任务数量。
